Article title: Xtract search API
HN text: We presented this project at innovationintelligencehackathon.com and today we are putting a url out for you to test and give us feedback. after talking to teams building agents that research companies to create outreach, we found few things that are very important to them. one of them is recency. When we prompted agents with outdated alert about companies, 4 out of 7 times, they came up with outdated insights, even when they had recent news in context. A bigger model didnt fix it. So we built search for ai-agents with usefulness score on top.
